scope: Offline cache correctness, optional progressive search, compact learned afterstate value; no ADB/runtime/default policy switch

training.teacher: corrected-cache fixed depth2, depth3 after two caps
training.sampling: afterstate every32 moves, first cap-count transition, and every8 moves in <=3 empty cells; unique board per episode, excludes goal afterstates
training.label: whole episode succeeds at three rank11 tiles =>1 else0; terminal losses only; limits invalidate labels
training.episode_balance: fit normalizes total sample weight to1 per episode seed
training.model: 4 patterns x4 cells x8 symmetries, stage0/1/2, sigmoid binary value; no new dependencies
training.validation_gate: validation Brier at least0.001 better than stage-prior baseline; else exclude learned arm from full-game selection; never describe output as calibrated true probability

screen.order: seeds ascending; policy order rotates by seed; sequential full-game runs, no concurrent heavy job
screen.selection: Start baseline; candidate requires strictly more wins than baseline. Choose highest wins, ties use lower observed seconds_per_move then declared order. Cost is descriptive, no equal elapsed efficiency claim unless aggregate search time within10% of baseline. If no candidate beats baseline, freeze best non-baseline as exploratory control, no default adoption.

holdout.policies: one frozen candidate vs original baseline_legacy only
holdout.order: paired alternating arm order by seed; sequential; no tuning or additional finalist after results
holdout.decision: support short-budget offline win improvement only if more wins, exact paired one-sided binomial p<=0.05 and no limits; report all outcomes/cost. Never transfer 10ms results to10s runtime.

ten_second_corpus.teacher: same frozen teacher as data, no learned policy
ten_second_corpus.selection: first one-cap and first two-cap snapshots per episode, select up to12 by cap/empty strata independent of arm outcome
ten_second_corpus.metric: actual completed depth/threshold, fallback, cut, wall time, nodes, decision disagreement; no full-game win-rate claim

sensitivity.source: same fixed corpus, not new win evidence
sensitivity.models: separate environment and solver tables; stress rank6 mass0.5% at max11, and reduce/increase rank>=3 probability25% with renormalization
sensitivity.metric: decision sensitivity and fixed-position evaluation; no invented default probabilities

limits: Do not relabel limit as loss; invalidates experiment until symmetric max-moves amendment before unblinding
freeze: code, model, source/engine SHA, configs and one finalist committed before holdout; previous control is diagnostics only
local_plateau: Bounded cycle of the3 distinct mechanisms and one frozen learned pilot. No hyperparameter tuning after holdout. Report lack of improvement honestly; not global optimum.
